A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same COGS research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison despite the revised title and appendix numbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original COGS experiments on ChartQAPro, MMC, and VisualWebBench, including dataset-mixture comparisons, reward ablations, and qualitative evaluations.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and adds prompting comparisons, a seed-size study, and evaluations using additional base models.

M1.justification: The decomposition, factor recomposition, and GRPO fine-tuning procedure, including all three reward formulations, is unchanged. Correcting GRPO's expanded name and revising Figure 2 terminology do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions use ChartQAPro, MMC-Bench, and VisualWebBench, with ChartQA and MultiUI supplying synthesis images. The new seed-size and backbone experiments retain the existing ChartQAPro task and data coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds Self-Consistency and Tree of Thoughts alongside the retained Decompositional CoT comparison. New Table 5 includes untuned Qwen2.5-VL-3B and LLaVA-v1.5-7B controls. The prose correction from Pixtral to Phi-4 is not an evaluated baseline replacement: Phi-4 already appears in v1's tables.

E3.justification: The added seed-size experiment uses 1%, 5%, 15%, 25%, and 33% of ChartQAPro while fixing the 67% evaluation split. Appendix C adds Qwen2.5-VL-3B and LLaVA-1.5-7B experiments with the same data, training hyperparameters, rewards, and evaluation protocol as the main experiment. Existing experimental settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V2 substantially broadens robustness analysis along two previously untested axes: dependence on seed-set size in Section 4.3/Figure 6, and dependence on backbone capacity and family in Appendix C/Table 5. The earlier factor-level, reward-model, SFT, and qualitative analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated experimental run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added experiments continue reporting point estimates without statistical uncertainty.

E6.justification: Existing results remain unchanged. Added Table 1 rows report 47.22% overall for Self-Consistency and 44.44% for Tree of Thoughts. Table 5 newly reports base-to-COGS accuracies of 36.22% to 38.68% for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 13.47% to 22.04% for LLaVA-v1.5-7B. Figure 6 adds an overall upward seed-size trend, with a small dip at 15%.

T1.justification: The factor definitions, reward equations, Proposition 3.1, proof sketch, and accompanying footnote retain the same mathematical substance. Changes are grammatical or notational.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about compositional synthesis, factor-level supervision, transferable reasoning, and extension to webpages. Renaming instruction synthesis to data synthesis does not redefine the contribution.

C2.justification: V2 attributes weaker performance from tiny seed sets to insufficient representativeness and interprets the backbone results as evidence that benefits are not specific to one size or model family. It also adds search-assisted process-reward guidance as future work; the earlier applicability boundaries remain.

D1.justification: The implementation appendix moves from C to D with the same hyperparameters, generator, software, hardware, training times, and evaluation instructions. Prompt templates and code/data access information are retained. The project link added to the abstract already appeared in v1's reproducibility statement.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds a focused comparison with Self-Instruct, Self-Rewarding Language Models, WizardLM, and Automatic Instruction Evolving, distinguishing visually grounded factor synthesis from text-based instruction generation. References for the new prompting baselines, Phi-4, and future process-reward-guided search are also added; the existing chart and GUI positioning remains.

P1.justification: V2 revises the title and COGS expansion, corrects terminology and the baseline description, expands several passages, adds acknowledgments, and inserts a backbone-ablation appendix. Most prose and the overall narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds the seed-size plot as Figure 6 and backbone results as Table 5, expands Table 1's prompting block, and revises labels and annotations in Figure 2. Other figures and examples are retained, with appendix renumbering and local layout shifts.

improvement.justification: The added prompting comparisons and seed-size/backbone ablations strengthen evidence about alternatives, data requirements, and robustness beyond v1's main configuration. Corrected baseline prose and clearer research positioning also help. The improvement is incremental: existing findings are retained, the new ablations cover only ChartQAPro, and uncertainty reporting remains absent.
